justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/constant/LongConstant.java, DefaultValue.java, InvokeDynamic.java, and JavaConstant.java plus the two LongConstant test classes. LongConstant is a small enum with only two constants (ZERO/ONE), a single helper nested class, and a narrow outgoing dependency set (StackManipulation, StackSize, MethodVisitor, Opcodes, Implementation.Context, and the HashCodeAndEqualsPlugin annotation). Its incoming use is also limited: I found 4 production call sites (DefaultValue.java:37, JavaConstant.java:566, InvokeDynamic.java:1224 and 1930) and 2 tests, which is not strong fan-in/fan-out evidence for a dependency hub.
